prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: wet dark marsh mud with puddles, footprints and bits of reed The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable top-down JRPG ground texture, wet dark marsh mud, shallow irregular puddles, scattered small pressed footprints, little broken reed fragments and sparse reed blades embedded in mud. Entire square edge-to-edge surface only; no borders, frames, objects, characters, text, focal point. Balanced distributed detail. Premium modern hi-bit 2D hand-placed pixel art, HD pixel-art JRPG tileset appearance. Uniform crisp perfectly square enlarged art pixels throughout (approximately 7–8 display pixels per art pixel), no antialiasing, blur, soft brush, photographic detail, noise, checkerboard dithering, or variable pixel sizes. Clear deliberate clusters of 3–10 art pixels. Rich earthy hue-shifted palettes, 4–6 shades per material, reddish purple saturated shadow mud, warm ochre yellow highlights, muted deep teal/brown puddles. Orthographic steep top-down RPG map view, no perspective. Neutral soft even overcast evening upper-left illumination; clean base colors, no cast shadows, darkness, local light sources, glow or vignette. Critically make left edge match right edge and top edge match bottom edge for seamless repeat, including all puddle and mud shapes crossing edges.
